original_synthesis: THE GAMELAN: an original sixteen-beat phrase on a pelog-like seven-tone set at 72 beats a minute (saron, bonang at double time, kenong, kempul, a soft gong every sixteen beats), synthesized from inharmonic partials with paired-instrument beating; far (dark, wet) at first, nearer with every swing of the torch; stops dead when the torch dies; one full-ensemble stroke at the end. Not a transcription of any real piece.
SCORE: a mid-band drone and a string cluster that tighten with the music and die with it (scripts/horror_score.py); a synthesized stinger under the gong and the last stroke; loop-quantised
